text: Rain of Khornate Blades
Shards of the weapons of the Blood God's failures rain down from the sky, vanishing forever alongside their masters on some nameless battlefield.
Skull-Throne Decree
When the seas of the world are replaced by blood, and its mountains are draped in mounds of skulls, our glorious names shall also be made known.
Skullfire Blaze
Dark Prince! Behold the fate of your pitiful servants! Now fit only to become tools for our great work of slaughter!
Chain-Blade Tempest
The Blood God points to the distant sky, and countless chain-blades wrap layer upon layer around those cowards flying above, tearing apart their wings and their faith.
Skull-Cleaving Wrath Axe
Neither short parapets, rotting flesh, nor metal walls can withstand the fury made manifest by this blood-soaked hand!
Hymn of Skulls
This is our hunting ground, countless prey awaiting slaughter, and we are the singers of blood!
Blood God's Trample
Our savagery and wrath do not discriminate between friend and foe; cowardly maggots are not fit to fight for the glory of the Blood God!
Brass Palace
The endless bloodshed of war has opened the gates to the Blood God's realm; all creatures shall be drawn into the Brass Palace to face his trial!
Glimpse of the Blood God
Even the briefest glance is enough to break the hearts of enemies in battle, as though their souls were torn from their bodies.
Blood Cyclone
Fanatics chant the Blood God's great name, and blood gathers into a raging cyclone, grinding down every resister in its path.
Chains of Purgatory
Brass chains reach out from the abyss of perdition, binding tight the ankles of cowards and sealing off every inch of sky within their sight.
Skull-Crushing Blow
A colossal blood-stained hand appears above the enemies of the Blood God, and a single blow is enough to crush their skulls to dust.
Weak Blood Deluge
The skull of the Lord of Change's living servant bursts apart, letting those fools who believe they command the winds of magic taste their own future!
Blood-Sigil Mist
Fanatics summon a great mark of the Blood God, granting allies more tenacious vitality and inspiring them to bring death and defeat upon their enemies.
Blood-Stained Lash
Slaying a servant of Khorne is never a wrong deed, but if you must do so, be sure to celebrate it as a proclamation of the Blood God's glory.
Brass Canopy
Molten brass flows ceaselessly across the sky above, disturbing the balance of the magical storm; only the chosen warriors of Khorne can sense this shift.
